chunks.text: Parque Nacional Pali Aike is a protected area in San Gregorio commune, Magallanes province, Chile. CONAF highlights its volcanic geomorphology, including low volcanic cones, natural caves, craters and lava fields.
Opening hours, seasonal closures, ticketing, visitor rules and road conditions for Pali Aike must be verified against current CONAF or Pases Parques information.
